elements.element: Vendor provides transition assistance on expiry or termination
elements.evidence: Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, TrueLink shall ... provide reasonable transition assistance

elements.element: Assistance available for up to 6 months
Return of Customer Data within 30 days of expiry/termination
elements.evidence: within thirty (30) days of such expiration or termination, return to Client all Client Content, Client Proprietary Information and other data of Client

elements.element: Return in a standard machine-readable format
elements.evidence: in a commonly used, machine-readable format" — "standard" format not expressly stated

elements.element: Deletion of Customer Data after return
elements.evidence: thereafter delete all such Client Content, Client Proprietary Information and data from its systems
certify such deletion to Client in writing

elements.element: At least 90 days of transition assistance
elements.evidence: transition assistance for up to six (6) months
within thirty (30) days of such expiration or termination, return to Client all Client Content ... in a commonly used, machine-readable format

reasons: The inserted Section 14a supplies all preferred mechanics except the express "standard" machine-readable format; it says "commonly used, machine-readable format", which falls short of the locked preferred wording.
Fallback is fully satisfied: six months of assistance exceeds 90 days and the 30-day export deadline runs from expiration or termination, not from a later request.
Data return, deletion and certification are unconditional; only the assistance limb is qualified by "at Client's request", which does not swallow the mandatory return obligation.
The edit is a concise insertion filling an absent clause and leaves the term, non-renewal, name-server and hosting-migration mechanics untouched; no undefined terms or contradictions introduced.
Recommended fix to reach preferred: change "commonly used, machine-readable format" to "standard machine-readable format".
